blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Power supply conditions in the Visayas may improve by mid-November as several power plants are expected to resume operations, according to the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP). Engr. Amado Otarra III, senior supervisor of NGCP Network Operations – Visayas System Operations, said there is a high possibility of improved power supply from mid-November through December if power plants currently undergoing repairs and maintenance return as scheduled. Among the plants expected to contribute to the improvement are Thermal Visayas Inc. Unit 2 and PEDC Unit 3. These have a capacity of more than 150 megawatts. READ […]...
